summary: Enlight Renewable Energy Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K dated October 13, 2026, announcing that it will release third-quarter 2026 financial results, for the period ended September 30, 2026, before the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange opens on November 3, 2026, and will host English and Hebrew conference calls the same day. The English call is at 8:00am ET/3:00pm Israel time; management, led by CEO Adi Leviatan, will present and take questions. Materials will be posted to the company's IR website. This is a routine earnings-scheduling notice with no transaction terms, no board recommendation, and no special-situation mechanics; no risk-arb angle applies.
